items.title: Obsidian 1.15.1 Desktop (Public)
items.summary: New Search Added Relevance sort option that sorts notes based on the best match for your query. Improvements Search Search and search filters in other views (e.g. Backlinks , Outline and Bookmarks ) now ignore accents, so cafe finds café . Search and suggestions now treat ø , ł , đ , ð , ħ and ı as o , l , d , d , h and i , and ß , æ , œ and þ as ss , ae , oe and th , which helps with German, French, Danish, Norwegian, Polish, Croatian, Serbian, Vietnamese, Icelandic, Faroese, Maltese, Turkish and Azerbaijani. For example, lodz finds Łódź and strasse finds Straße . Results now appear much fast…

items.title: Obsidian-plugin-dev-kit: build, scan, test and release a plugin from one dev dependency
items.summary: Hi all. I maintain three plugins: Snipsy, Dashy and Garmy. Each had its own build script, lint config, release script and test harness, and they drifted. A fix for the mobile build reached two of the three plugins; the third was bundled for Node, pulled in code that reads process.env , and failed on every phone while desktop worked fine. I moved the shared tooling into one dev dependency, obsidian-plugin-dev-kit (CLI opdk ), and all three plugins use it now.
